messages:
tara: quick FYI, bringing up argo-9b on staging (hf -> redwood int4). FP16 evals looked fine but int4 logits are permuted for certain prefixes.
edward: permuted how? give an example short run.
tara: small repro: prompt "Translate: The cat sat on the mat."
FP16 top3 tokens: ['The','cat','sat']
INT4 top3 tokens: ['cat','The','sat']
jess: that ordering flip screams proj matrix layout or head interleave mismatch. did the exporter flatten heads differently?
tara: converter used default head_layout=NH, but argo checkpoint notes mention NHW (interleaved pairs).
omar: also check rotary phase sign. if sin/cos tables get transposed with head swap you can get apparent token-order perturbations that only show on short prefixes.
edward: can we run a small headmap probe to compare per-head logits for the same step? I have a script: 
```
# head probe
python tools/head_probe.py --model converted_argo.bin --prompt "Translate: The cat" --dump-per-head
```

jess: ran it: head 0..3 align, heads 4..7 show a cyclic shift by 1 in logits. suggests headgroup of size 4 is permuted.
tara: interesting. when I re-converted forcing `--head_group=4 --proj_layout=interleaved` the sample ordering matched FP16 but perplexity still slightly worse (~+0.6).
omar: tiny perf delta could be quant scale mismatch per head. try asymmetric per-head scale calibration after mapping. we recently added `--calibrate-per-head` flag in convert tool.
edward: heads-up, CI test found a tokenizer edge-case: argo vocab contains an alternate apostrophe (U+2019) that HF fast tokenizer normalizes to ASCII `'` by default. that causes token id shift for possessives, shifting KV-cache offsets.
jess: combine fixes: (1) enforce head_group & proj_layout options during conversion; (2) run per-head asymmetric calibrate; (3) normalizer that maps U+2019 -> ASCII apostrophe and emit tokenizer_hash metadata.
tara: I patched convert: autodetect head_group by scanning for repeating patterns in per-head weight norms and then try proj_layout candidates and pick best ppl. quick local run: autodetect picked group=4/layout=interleaved, after calibrate hellaswag acc rose from 40.2 -> 56.9 (FP16 57.1).
edward: awesome. create RED-920 and add an integration test that runs the head_probe and tokenizer-normalizer smoke before marking as onboarded.
ml-ci-bot: created issue RED-920: "argo-9b int4 headgroup/proj-layout + tokenizer normalization" assigned to tara.
omar: note for Console: include `proj_layout` and `head_group` fields in model metadata and show a warning if client tokenizer_hash != model.tokenizer_hash.
tara: will open PR with autodetect + docs. target: small merge tomorrow AM, full eval run overnight. will drop logs in the ticket.
